jobs.description:
My client is looking for a Business Consultant POS Systems to support and improve the technology behind 400  Point-of-Sale terminals across 40 stores in Belgium and the Netherlands. This role is central to ensuring seamless store operations while contributing to major transformation projects in an evolving omnichannel retail environment.

Jobomschrijving

As part of a close-knit international team, you will act as the link between business stakeholders, IT teams and external vendors. You will ensure the stability and evolution of the POS landscape while helping prepare the organisation for future challenges, including the replacement of its current POS platform.

• Ensure the availability and performance of POS systems across all stores.
• Manage incidents and provide second and third-line support.
• Gather business requirements and translate them into practical solutions.
• Coordinate with software vendors and implementation partners.
• Support the rollout of new functionalities such as self-checkout, self-scan and advanced pricing and promotional features.
• Contribute to projects focused on modernising store operations and enhancing the customer experience.
• Work closely with SAP teams to ensure seamless integration between retail systems.
• Support omnichannel initiatives and the growing importance of eCommerce within the organisation.
• Play an active role in the future replacement of the current POS solution.

You understand retail operations and enjoy working in a business-facing IT role where you can combine analysis, process improvement and technology. You may come from a background such as: Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, Application Manager, Retail System Specialist, POS Consultant, Store Operation IT Specialist.

• Dutch is mandatory, Professional level of English, French is a strong plus.
• Experience in a retail environment.
• Understanding of store operations and retail business processes.
• Experience with POS systems is highly desirable.
• Ability to translate business needs into effective IT solutions.
• Experience working with vendors and multiple stakeholders.
• SAP knowledge is considered an advantage.

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

Jobomschrijving

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Jobomschrijving

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.
Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.

• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.
Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Our client is a leading international logistics group operating within the temperature-controlled supply chain sector. Active across multiple European markets, the company combines operational excellence, strong financial backing, automation, and ambitious growth plans. The environment is dynamic, entrepreneurial, performance-driven, and focused on continuous improvement and innovation

Jobomschrijving

• Define and execute the facilities, maintenance, and engineering strategy across key operational sites.
• Ensure maximum equipment availability, reliability, and operational continuity.
• Lead preventive and corrective maintenance programmes for automated infrastructure and technical assets.
• Manage engineering teams, external contractors, and specialised service providers.
• Develop and monitor maintenance KPIs, budgets, and performance standards.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives to increase efficiency and reduce downtime.
• Oversee major capital expenditure projects, site upgrades, and infrastructure investments.

• Support automation initiatives and technological enhancements across operations.
• Collaborate closely with operations, finance, procurement, and executive leadership teams.

• Degree in Engineering, Industrial Maintenance, Electromechanics, Facilities Management, or related discipline.
• Extensive leadership experience within logistics, manufacturing, industrial, automated warehousing, cold chain, or similar asset-intensive environments.
• Strong expertise in maintenance management, engineering operations, and technical infrastructure.
• Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary teams and major investment projects.
• Proven capability to manage budgets, suppliers, and performance improvement programmes.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication capabilities.
• Fluent English required; additional European languages are considered an advantage.
• Comfortable operating within a fast-growing, international organisation.

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

Our client is an established international professional services organization.

Jobomschrijving

• Map and document end-to-end processes across the different Business Services functions.
• Meet with key stakeholders to understand how processes are currently performed in practice.
• Document current-state ("as-is") processes, including responsibilities, systems, approvals and dependencies.
• Identify gaps, inconsistencies and opportunities to create clearer and more efficient ways of working.
• Develop practical future-state ("to-be") processes and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
• Create clear process documentation using tools such as Visio or PowerPoint.
• Ensure critical operational knowledge is properly captured and documented.
• Review and centralize existing supplier contracts, including ownership, expiry dates, renewal periods and key obligations.
• Review insurance arrangements and help identify potential gaps, overlaps or inconsistencies.
• Establish a practical approach for monitoring contract renewals, expiry dates and related actions.
• Collaborate with Procurement and Legal to ensure the appropriate contracts and governance are in place.
• Review and improve processes related to signing rights and delegated authorities.
• Take end-to-end ownership of deliverables and ensure the work progresses independently with limited day-to-day supervision.

• Demonstrated experience as a Business Process Consultant, Process Improvement Consultant, Business Operations Consultant or process-oriented Business Analyst.
• Strong hands-on experience with business process mapping and documentation.
• Able to conduct stakeholder interviews and translate complex information into clear and practical processes.
• Experience creating as-is/to-be process maps and SOPs.
• Previous exposure to contract management, supplier governance or operational governance is highly valuable.
• Strong analytical and organizational skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Autonomous and execution-focused: you are comfortable taking ownership and delivering the work from start to finish.
• Pragmatic and hands-on profile rather than purely strategic or advisory.
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required.
• Knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a strong advantage.

Some people wait for opportunities.

Others create them.

We're looking for a Business Manager who thrives on opening new doors, building powerful client relationships, and turning business challenges into consulting solutions.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established Belgian consulting company with more than 15 years of success and a strong reputation in technology consulting. Over the last few years, the company has made a strategic shift towards one of the fastest-growing markets: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Machine Learning and AI Leadership.

Today, their challenge isn't finding talent.

It's finding enough clients for the exceptional consultants already in the business.

That's where you come in.

Description

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities and growing a portfolio of clients across Brussels and Belgium.

From first contact to long-term partnership, you'll own the entire sales cycle.

You will:

• Identify and approach new clients
• Build relationships with decision-makers and executives
• Understand business challenges and propose the right consulting solution
• Sell AI expertise
• Negotiate commercial agreements and close deals
• Work closely with recruiters to match the right consultants to client needs
• Follow consultants on-site and ensure long-term client satisfaction
• Continuously expand your network and market knowledge
 

• You know how staffing and consulting work.
• You've already sold projects, consultants, services or expertise.
• You enjoy hunting for opportunities and building lasting commercial relationships.
• You probably have: 
• 2 to 6 years of experience in consulting, staffing, recruitment or IT services
• Experience developing new accounts from scratch
• A strong commercial mindset and entrepreneurial spirit
• The ability to challenge, influence and convince stakeholders
• Fluency in English, French and/or Dutch
• A passion for business development and people
• Most importantly: 
• You don't wait for leads.
• You create them.

As Project Lead, you will be responsible for setting up and implementing a new HR Shared Service Centre. Working closely with HR and business stakeholders, you will drive process improvements, manage transitions, and ensure an efficient and compliant HR service delivery model.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and implement the HR Shared Service operating model, including services, governance, and team structure.

• Standardize HR processes across countries and support the implementation of HR technology and self-service tools.

• Ensure compliance with labor laws, data privacy regulations, and local legal requirements.

• Lead the migration of HR processes into the Shared Service Centre, including documentation, training, and go-live activities.

• Act as the main point of contact for HR leaders, project sponsors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Manage project plans, timelines, risks, and status reporting.

• Drive change management, communication, and training initiatives to support successful adoption.

• Establish performance metrics, SLA monitoring, and continuous improvement programs to enhance service quality.

 

We are looking for an experienced HR transformation professional who can lead the design and implementation of a new HR Shared Service Centre in an international environment.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; MBA or postgraduate qualification is a plus.

• 6-10 years of experience in HR consulting, HR Shared Services, HR outsourcing (HRO/BPO), or HR transformation projects.

• At least 2-3 years of hands-on experience in designing and implementing HR Shared Service Centres.

• Proven track record of leading large-scale, international HR transformation or shared services projects.

• Strong stakeholder management and project leadership skills.

• Excellent communication skills and fluent English.

Do you hold a valid CE driving licence and code 95? Are you already living in Belgium and looking for a stable job? And do you want to work at a reliable transport company where you can drive modern trucks and be home almost every evening?

For a leading frozen food transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we're recruiting a CE truck driver for delivering frozen food products to customers throughout Belgium and its neighbouring countries. Dutch isn't required for this job, so you're free to apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE truck driver, lorry driver, or HGV driver, you will ensure the safe and on-time delivery of frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods
• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany 
• Average of 12h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)
• Between 5 to 15 stops/day
• Never on weekends or on holidays
Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence and code 95
• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country
• Has a good level of English
• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes
• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby   truck cannot be taken home)
Experience as a CE truck driver is a big advantage but not required. You can also apply if you've just gotten your CE driving licence!

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).

Are you ready to take charge on a production line? Do you enjoy working with your hands and being part of a close team?

Join one of the world’s leading mushroom companies, right here in your region. As an operator, you’ll help keep the line running — adjusting machines, switching molds, and sealing mushroom boxes. You work 5 days a week, with either the full weekend off or a weekday off if you work Saturday. Your shift starts at 6am or 8am depending on the season.

What you can expect:

• A key role in a solid, reliable team
• Hands-on work with real responsibility
• A company that’s big in the global mushroom market
• Long-term opportunity for people who want to grow
Sound like your kind of job? Let’s talk!

• You’re someone who keeps an eye on the bigger picture — you think ahead, spot small issues before they become big ones, and help the line run like clockwork.
• Experience in a production environment in food in necassery.
• The working language in the company is English, so Dutch is not required.
